news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹60.34 (up from ₹59.81 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹336.5b (up 6.1% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹35.0b (flat on FY 2025). Profit margin: 10% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 3.5%. Revenue is forecast to grow 10% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 17% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 34% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Aurobindo Pharma Limited (NSEI:AUROPHARMA) announces an Equity Buyback for 5,423,728 shares, representing 0.93% for INR 8,000 million.
news.body: Aurobindo Pharma Limited (NSEI:AUROPHARMA) announces a share repurchase program. Under the program, the company will repurchase up to  54,23,728 shares, representing 0.93% of its issued share capital for a total of INR 7,500 million. The shares will be repurchased for a price of INR 1,460 per share. The purpose of the program is to enhance the overall return to shareholders, to improve earnings per share and other key ratios such as return on net worth and return on assets. The offer will be funded out of free reserves (Including securities premium) of the company and/or such other sources as may be permitted by Buyback Regulations of the Companies Act. The company has fixed July 30, 2024, as the record date for the offer.
